# A week in Parliament

> Hansard for both Houses. Captured sittings from 2026-11-16 to 2026-11-19.

## Start here

- [Hansard collection](https://chris-page-gov.github.io/okf-hansard/november/hansard.json): Start here for all captured sittings and historical matches.
- [Ask your AI about Hansard](https://chris-page-gov.github.io/okf-hansard/november/ask.md): Copy the voice prompt and find evidence.

- [OKF 0.3 Markdown index](https://chris-page-gov.github.io/okf-hansard/okf/index.md): Open this small index first.
- [Machine directory](https://chris-page-gov.github.io/okf-hansard/okf-public-access.json): Coverage, endpoints and SHA-256 digests.
- [Coverage and verification](https://chris-page-gov.github.io/okf-hansard/coverage.json): Check dates and search limits before answering.
- [Compact-core question walkthrough](https://chris-page-gov.github.io/okf-hansard/core-walkthrough.html): Answer from this entry point's own source scope.
- [Full-graph question walkthrough](https://chris-page-gov.github.io/okf-hansard/walkthrough.html): Follow the separate graph evidence and its limits.
- [Companion and views](https://chris-page-gov.github.io/okf-hansard/use-with-ai.html): See the evidence and its source links.

Cite the exact Hansard passages. Treat shared name or alias matches as leads.
